heading: How to Change Amap to English on iPhone & Android
intro: Use this page to set the interface language and check whether an English search leads to the right place. If menus are already English but a hotel or station is still in Chinese, go straight to the place-name checks. For walking, metro and station-entrance planning after setup, use the separate Amap navigation guide.
quickAnswer: Amap Global lists English support. Update the official app and choose English in a first-run language picker or language setting if offered. If that control is missing, use the iPhone or Android checks below. English menus, Chinese business names and an incorrect destination are different problems: choose what you see in the helper to get the relevant next step. Keep the hotel or station name in Chinese for checking the result.

sections.title: Choose the official Amap download for your phone
items: Use the official app-store links below and compare the app name and publisher. Amap is also known as Gaode / 高德地图; the official store listing uses AMap Global. Store availability can differ by country and device.

For iPhone, the listing identifies AutoNavi Information Technology Co. Ltd. and includes English among its languages. The Android link below is for package com.autonavi.minimap. Avoid choosing an unrelated app solely because its title says English maps.

items: Changing the interface language and selecting the right destination are separate tasks. Preserve the Chinese booking details even after English is enabled.
For a driver or hotel receptionist, the Chinese property name, branch and entrance are more useful than an unverified English translation. Ask the property to confirm them if the booking is unclear.

sections.title: How to switch Amap to English
items: Update the official Amap app and open it with a working internet connection.
If a first-run language picker appears, select English. Otherwise look in the app settings for Language, 语言 or 语言设置. Use the menu translations below when needed.
Reopen Amap and check a main control such as search or the route screen. A change in a spoken navigation voice is not sufficient evidence that the interface changed.
If English or the language control is absent, use the relevant phone-specific section. If menus are English but a listing remains Chinese, use the place-name checks instead.

sections.title: iPhone: check the app language
items: Start with the in-app language picker or settings. The official iPhone listing includes English, but a particular menu position is not guaranteed across versions.

In iPhone Settings, find the Amap app entry and look for an app-language preference if offered. Recent iOS versions group individual app settings under Apps. Select English, then reopen Amap and inspect the main controls.

If no app-language choice appears, return to the in-app checks and official update. Keep the Chinese destination from your booking available. A missing language control alone does not establish that changing your App Store country will solve it.

sections.title: Android: check App languages
items: Check the language setting inside the official Amap app first.

On supported Android phones, open Settings, System, Languages, then App languages. Choose Amap and English only if they appear. Google notes that some of these instructions require Android 14 or later; manufacturer wording can differ.
If the setting is offered but does not take effect, restart the app with a working network connection.

If Amap or English is missing from that list, the system-level control is not available for that installed setup. Use the in-app setting and the Chinese destination fallback while checking the current official app information.

sections.title: If English is missing or Amap is still in Chinese

rows: Try the language picker or your phone-specific checks; inspect a main control after reopening.
Check the official app and version. The system app-language control only works for supported apps and languages.
Menus are English; a hotel or attraction is Chinese
Keep the interface setting and verify the place with its Chinese booking name.
English search returns the wrong branch
Use the Chinese address, city and exact hotel branch before planning a route.
An airport and a station share a place name
Compare the Chinese suffix: 机场 is airport and 站 is station. Confirm the terminal or station named on the ticket.
A service asks for sign-in or payment verification
Handle that service requirement separately; changing the interface language does not complete it.

sections.title: Test an English place search before travel
items: These are destination-checking examples. Compare the live app result with your ticket or booking before selecting it.
For a hotel, use the Chinese property name and complete address from the confirmation. Add the branch and entrance if the property provides them. Save that information outside the app for arrival.
Before starting a route, check that its destination pin and final entrance match the booking. Language setup alone does not establish that the selected destination is correct.

rows: Airport and correct terminal, not the railway station
Different airport from Hongqiao; use the airport and terminal on your ticket

sections.title: Before you rely on Amap at the airport
items: Open the app and check the interface before departure, while you still have time to troubleshoot.
Keep the hotel name, complete Chinese address and contact details outside the app.
Prepare mobile data or a working connection for live checks. Do not assume a saved screenshot is live navigation.
Confirm the airport terminal or railway station on the ticket and check the last part of the route to the actual entrance.
For a ride, check the separate pickup and payment requirements in the DiDi guide or the service you choose.

faqs.question: How do I change Amap to English?
faqs.answer: Update the official app and choose English in its first-run picker or language settings if offered. Language can appear as 语言 or 语言设置. If the control is missing, check the app-language options on your phone; availability and menu order vary by version.

faqs.question: Can I use Amap in English on iPhone?
faqs.answer: The official Amap Global App Store listing includes English. Check the in-app language picker and the app-specific language preference in iPhone Settings if available, then reopen the app. Individual place names and service screens may still contain Chinese.

faqs.question: How do I change Amap language on Android?
faqs.answer: Try the app language settings first. On supported phones, Settings, System, Languages and App languages is another place to check. This only works when the installed app supports the Android control and lists English; it is not available for every build.

faqs.question: Why is Amap still in Chinese after I choose English?
faqs.answer: Check whether only a place listing is Chinese or the main controls are also unchanged. Reopen the updated app with a working connection and review its language setting. Use the Chinese destination name from your booking while you check; changing the interface does not translate all content.

faqs.question: Can I search Amap using an English address?
faqs.answer: Try the English place name, then confirm its Chinese name, city and exact branch or entrance. If results are missing or ambiguous, paste the Chinese address from the booking. An airport and a railway station can share a district name but be different destinations.

faqs.question: Are Amap, Gaode and AMap Global the same map service?
faqs.answer: Amap is also known as Gaode or 高德地图, and its official international app-store listing is named AMap Global. Use the official store link and compare the publisher or Android package rather than installing an unrelated app with a similar English name.

faqs.question: Does choosing English translate every hotel and shop name?
faqs.answer: An English interface does not guarantee an English label for every listing, entrance or service. Keep the Chinese name and full address from your booking and compare them with the selected map result.

faqs.question: What should I check after switching Amap to English?
faqs.answer: Check a main control, then try a destination you can verify from a ticket or booking. Confirm its city, branch, airport terminal or station and final entrance. Save the Chinese destination details outside the app for arrival.
